$comment: The workflow agent behind the desk, in the shape Katonic's workflow builder saves. Build it in Studio from a Blank workflow with these four steps. The agent step hands the publication to the published Regulatory Monitoring Agent; the approve step holds the run for the compliance officer group; the out step returns the result to the caller. Nothing in this repository applies it to an installation.

identity.description: A publication arrives, the Regulatory Monitoring Agent drafts the gap analysis, a compliance officer approves, the result is returned.

nodes.title: A publication arrives
nodes.sub: By hand, from the feed, or on the schedule

config.$comment: source=manual for a publication dropped in or sent by the desk; source=webhook for the bank's feed; source=schedule runs the sweep on weekday mornings. One in step takes one source: make one workflow per way in, or start with manual.
